```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(arrow)
```

Run this to reduce the size of the datafile
```{r}
ds <- open_dataset("../results/data_ABM.csv", format = "csv")

write_dataset(
  ds,
  path = "../results/data_ABM",
  format = "parquet"
)

```


# Fig 2.D


Loading the data
```{r}
df <- open_dataset("../results/data_ABM")

df_beta_distrib <- df |>
  group_by(gen, p, sd, alpha, beta) |>
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta),
    variance = (alpha * beta) / ((alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1)),
    gen = gen + 1,
    w = (50*w + 50) / 100
  ) |>
  collect()
```


## Fig 2.D.1 (task performance)
```{r}
df_plot <- df_beta_distrib %>%
  filter(p == 0.2 & sd == 0.2) %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = round(transmission_quality, digits = 2)) %>%
  filter(transmission_quality %in% c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) %>%
  group_by(gen, transmission_quality) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = as.factor(transmission_quality))


col_palette <- c("#149911", "#4EA60D", "#88B309", "#C3BF04", "#FFC800")



p <- df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(
    x = gen,
    y = perf,
    group = transmission_quality,
    color = transmission_quality
  )) +
  geom_line(aes(color = transmission_quality), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3, shape = 15) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  # scale_y_continuous(
  #   limits = c(-0.1, 1.5),
  #   breaks = seq(0, 2, by = 0.50),
  #   expand = c(.001, .001)
  # ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_palette) +
  labs(y = "Task Performance", x = "Generation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(8, "pt"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(10, "pt"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 24
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 24
    ),
    plot.margin = margin(15, 15, 20, 15),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p

# ggsave(
#   p,
#   filename = "../../2023_transmission_of_model/analysis/output/figures/manuscript/illustrator/fig2/fig2_D_1.pdf",
#   width = 6,
#   height = 4
# )
```

# SI. 

## Parameter sweep grid of p / sd

check for best fit
```{r}
df_dist <- df_beta_distrib %>%
  filter(gen == 10) %>%
  filter(p %in% c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)) %>%
  filter(sd %in% c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8)) %>%
  filter(transmission_quality %in% c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)) %>%
  mutate(
    dist = sqrt(
      (perf - 1.1)^2 +
        (model_knowledge - 0.5)^2 +
        (w - 0.67)^2
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(dist)

df_dist
```

## Single run

data loading
```{r}
df <- open_dataset("../results/data_ABM")

df_single_run <- df |>
  filter(p == 0.2 & sd == 0.2) |>
  mutate(
    transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta),
    variance = (alpha * beta) / ((alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1)),
    gen = gen + 1,
    w = (50*w + 50) / 100
  ) |>
  filter(transmission_quality == 0.8) |>
  collect()

df_behaviour <- read.csv("../../2023_transmission_of_model/analysis/data/data_adv.csv")

df_plot_behaviour <- df_behaviour %>%
  group_by(gen) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(score_corrected),
    model_knowledge = mean(pl2_understanding)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "behaviour") %>%
  mutate(sim = 99)
```

### Performance

```{r}
df_plot_all_run <- df_single_run %>%
  group_by(gen, sim) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "run")

df_plot_summary <- df_single_run %>%
  group_by(gen) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "summary")

df_plot <- bind_rows(df_plot_all_run, df_plot_summary, df_plot_behaviour)

df_plot %>%
  ggplot( 
    aes(
      x = gen,
      y = perf,
      linewidth = type,
      color = type,
      group = interaction(type, sim)
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(run = 0.3, summary = 1, behaviour = 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(run = "grey", summary = "black", behaviour = "red")) +
  theme_minimal()
```

## W
```{r}
df_beta_distrib <- df |>
  group_by(gen, alpha, beta) |>
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    transmission_quality = alpha / (alpha + beta),
    variance = (alpha * beta) / ((alpha + beta)^2 * (alpha + beta + 1)),
    gen = gen + 1,
    w = (50*w + 50) / 100
  ) |>
  collect()
```


```{r}
df_plot <- df_beta_distrib %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = round(transmission_quality, digits = 1)) %>%
  group_by(gen, transmission_quality) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(transmission_quality = as.factor(transmission_quality))

df_plot %>%
  ggplot( aes(
    x = gen,
    y = w,
    group = transmission_quality,
    color = transmission_quality
    )) +
  geom_line(aes(color = transmission_quality), linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(1, 10),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(0.001, 0.001)
  ) +

  # ) +
  labs(y = "w", x = "Generation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", size = .8),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(8, "pt"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(10, "pt"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18, colour = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      margin = margin(t = 10),
      size = 24
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      margin = margin(r = 10),
      size = 24
    ),

    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

## Lock p, alpha, beta (sd is moving)


```{r}
df_spec <- df %>%
  filter(p == 1, beta == 1, alpha == 5) %>%
  mutate(gen = gen + 1)


df_mean <- df_spec  %>%
  group_by(gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "average") %>%
  mutate(sim = NA)

df_sim <- df_spec %>%
  group_by(sim, gen, sd) %>%
  summarise(
    perf = mean(perf),
    model_knowledge = mean(model_knowledge),
    w = mean(w)
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "sim")


p_perf <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = perf, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = perf), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Task Performance",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-0.5, 1.5),
    breaks = seq(-0.5, 1.5, by = 0.50),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


p_model_knowledge <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = model_knowledge), size = 2) +
  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "Model Knowledge",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)


p_w <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = w, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +

  labs(
    x = "Generation",
    y = "W",
    shape = " ",
    colour = " "
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    breaks = seq(1, 10, by = 1),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  facet_wrap(~sd, ncol = 5)
```

```{r}
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.2),
    expand = c(.001, .001)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
```
```{r}
  facet_wrap(~alpha, ncol = 5)


p_w <- df_sim %>%
  ggplot( aes(x = gen, y = w, group = sim)) +
  geom_line(alpha=0.6, color = "grey", size = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = df_mean, aes(x = gen, y = w), size = 2) +

  ) +

  ) +
```
